usedFor: Discord is where your community talks, and Slack is where your team reads. When “New Message Posted to Channel” fires in Discord, “Send Message” in Slack can post it to a team channel.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted to Channel” in Discord, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: It is the plainest way to bring community chatter to the team, and “Send Message” takes a channel name or ID and can schedule the post. “Send Interactive Message” adds buttons if the team must reply.

watchOut: “New Message Posted to Channel” is polling, so messages reach Slack after the next check. An automation's post to a Slack channel also waits for your approval today.
